map.📚 深度解析：宠物美容造型图鉴: 📚 In-depth analysis: Pet Grooming Style Guide
map.按品种选造型：不同犬种（如贵宾、比熊、雪纳瑞）有标志造型，图鉴按品种列出可选风格: Choose a style by breed: different dog breeds (poodle, bichon, schnauzer and so on) have signature cuts; the guide lists the available styles and suitable occasions by breed, so you do not blindly follow trends and ruin the coat.
map.按季节与功能调整：夏季清爽短毛、冬季留长保暖；工作犬侧重清爽利落减少挂脏，家庭陪: Adjust by season and function: a cool short coat in summer, a longer coat in winter for warmth; working dogs favour a clean, practical cut that picks up less dirt, while companion dogs can lean towards cute styles.
map.术前/术后与皮肤问题期：皮肤病、外伤期间不宜复杂造型，图鉴提示优先医疗护理而非美: Around surgery and during skin problems: elaborate styling is unsuitable when there is skin disease or injury; the guide advises prioritising medical care over grooming.
map.示例：为金毛寻回犬选夏季清爽造型: Example: choosing a cool summer cut for a Golden Retriever
map.金毛属双层被毛犬，夏季推荐「清爽修剪」（身体留 2–3 cm、腹部与脚底修薄散热: Golden Retrievers are double-coated, so a cool trim is recommended in summer (2–3 cm left on the body, with the belly and paw pads thinned for heat dissipation), keeping the waterproof undercoat while lowering the risk of heatstroke. Switch breeds in the guide to see the key points, tools and cautions for that style. Note: the undercoat must never be shaved off, or thermoregulation is affected.
map.不同品种多久美容一次？: How often should different breeds be groomed?
map.长毛/卷毛犬（贵宾、比熊、可蒙）约 4–6 周一次，短毛犬（法斗、巴哥）6–8: Long-haired or curly-coated dogs (poodle, bichon, komondor) about every 4–6 weeks; short-haired dogs (French bulldog, pug) only need cleaning care every 6–8 weeks; cats usually groom themselves, with brushing care every 4–8 weeks for healthy cats. The exact interval varies with coat type, activity level and season.
map.造型选择有哪些注意事项？: What should I watch out for when choosing a style?
map.①双层被毛犬（萨摩、金毛、哈士奇）勿剃光底层，仅修外层散热；②老年/幼龄犬应激大: 1. For double-coated dogs (Samoyed, Golden Retriever, Husky) never shave the undercoat off — only trim the outer coat for cooling. 2. Senior and very young dogs get stressed easily, so shorten each session. 3. With red or swollen skin, wounds or parasites, see a vet before grooming. 4. For white dogs, watch tear stains and the safety of coat-whitening products. This guide is popular-science reference only; have the work done by a professional groomer.
